items.details: London Stansted to Bishkek via Istanbul; she paid 515 GBP return including a checked bag.

items.details: 4x4 rental at $60/day ($900 total / $450 each for two weeks) - the best way to get around.

items.name: Golden Hotel
items.details: 2 nights. She stayed at Golden Hotel: clean, spacious bathrooms, free breakfast, 24h reception.

items.details: Soviet-era sights: Ala Too Square, State History Museum, Victory Square, Osh Bazaar.

items.details: Food spots not far from Golden Hotel.

items.name: Five Resto
items.details: Food spot not far from Golden Hotel.

items.details: Day stop 1.5-2h from Bishkek; 11th-century Silk Road minaret, climb inside for 85 som (~0.75 GBP); Balbal statues.

items.name: Lake Issyk-Kul
items.details: 3 nights, based in Bokonbayevo village on the south shore; local beach Yurtochnyy Gordon Ton.

items.name: Guesthouse Gulmira
items.details: Family-run, yurts + rooms, free breakfast; organised her eagle hunting excursion.

items.name: Eagle hunting show
items.details: Century-old tradition: watch eagle training, hold birds, archery; ~1.5h, 1200 som (~10 GBP), organised via Guesthouse Gulmira.

items.name: Mountain hiking
items.details: 3 nights. Hikes: Turnaly-Kol Panorama (13km, 2862m, ~5h), Kok-Bel Waterfall (12km, easy), Eki-Chat Yurt Camp (17km).

items.name: Mine Hostel
items.details: Small, clean, comfortable; free breakfast; dinner 500 som (~4.50 GBP); owner helps with hiking routes.

items.name: Kezgin Guesthouse
items.details: 1 night, long 8-10h scenic drive via Fairytale Canyon; stayed at Kezgin Guesthouse - great complimentary breakfast.

items.name: Tash Rabat yurt camps / Stone Rabat
items.details: 2 nights at 3200m. Visit Stone Rabat caravanserai (entry 100 som ~0.90 GBP); no phone reception - stock supplies in Naryn.
